global|beneficial_ownership.reason: Large-holder filings (13D/13G, TR-1, JP 5% rule) are national regimes covered by member-country columns (us, uk, jp, ea); LME positions banding is already an existing global row for commodity concentration.

global|participant_type_flow.reason: Investor-type exchange flow is published by national exchanges (kr, tw, jp, ind, cn columns); supranational venues (LME, ICE Futures Europe) publish participant classes only as COT, already existing rows.

global|public_chain.reason: No international institution publishes public-chain large-holder transfer data; the class is a desk-side sensor read from the raw public chain itself, not an institutional publication (and no crypto venue may be used).

global|execution_routing.reason: Routing/execution-quality disclosure is a national rule (US Rule 605/606 in us column; MiFID RTS 27/28 suspended); no supranational body publishes routing statistics.

global|mortgage_convexity.reason: Agency-MBS convexity and refinancing is a US market construct covered by the us column (NY Fed agency-MBS operations, GSE data); no supranational MBS series exists.

global|observed_price_footprint.reason: Global-only class sourced from the desk's own MT5 bars, not from any institutional publisher; nothing external to resolve.
